reviews.text: Negative energy. App has distorted, angry, and even violent interpretations of the tarot cards. I do NOT recommend this app. There are many apps to choose from that are helpful. Bad Juju altogether.

What happened to you?. Taro of the Universe had an ad during the card if the day spread after the initial paragraph. That was fine. Now there are five ads and I haven’t even gotten a word about the card. Wow! You have gone downhill.
Ok free apps come with ads…. But this one comes with super intrusive ads

New update removed symbology. I’ve always liked this app and was one of my daily go to’s, but they’ve removed what made this app stand apart from others, and that was the symbology explanations. It identified symbols that I had never noticed. Not sure why it would be beneficial to exclude this aspect.

Please fix this problem. I really like this app. And it has worked very nicely but the last week or so even tho I subscribe mi that I get advertisements and I am blocked from the interpretation if this doesn’t get fixed I will not pay for this again. 
Please fix this issue . I will update my review . Thanks .

reviews.text: The new update :-/. It was working perfectly up until this new update, now I can’t even get on it boo :-/
The app is great., but there is a bug. I love the app and break down of the symbols. But everytime I look at my saved spreads, the app closes out on me.
Ads ads ads. Every card you flip there’s a new ad!!! 😡
awesome app. Wonderful app I wanted to learn the tarot cards and this has been a fun way to do this.
Ridiculous Ads. I’ve downloaded a few tarot apps in my day and this one is by far the worst as far as ads go. The cards are not really accurate either. Bummer because this one has some good spreads.

Buena aplicación pero los anuncios son horribles!. Me gusta la aplicación, y siento que las definiciones de las cartas son muy útiles y profundos. Solo espero que estuviera explicaciones de las cartas volteadas también! 

Tal vez me molestan mucho los anuncios... entiendo qué hay que tener anuncios en un app gratis pero a menudo son muy feos y ruidosos, y es horrible cuando estás intentando hacer un “mood” de Tarot y estes anuncios interrumpen la onda.
Same card description no matter the card. I would pull a card for the day and no matter what card it was the description was the same. Deleted.

Too many ads. This is a nice app, but I have deleted it from my phone and will never use it again. Why? Reading Tarot is a spiritual thing greatly disturbed by a new loud ad after every card is read. Don't use it!
Un tirage. Amélioration et espoir assez juste ce soir

Thank you. So easy to use and understand. 
I always stayed away from Tarot cards because I was never taught to read them with objectivity. I actually feared them. 
This app has made me so comfortable with using them that I start my day off with a card and check in with them when facing a challenge. 
Ultimately, the answer is within, but this guides you to reach it with more clarity of what I can and cannot control. 🙏🏻❤️🙏🏻❤️🙏🏻❤️
